name: EOS Lelego
rootCause: The attacker malisringho continually initiated 35 game requests to the EOS Lelego contract llgcontract1., eventually guessing 27 times, making a total profit of 6,282.5 EOS, and then successfully transferring 6,500 EOS to the Binance Exchange.

descriptions.text: The attacker malisringho continually initiated 35 game requests to the EOS Lelego contract llgcontract1., eventually guessing 27 times, making a total profit of 6,282.5 EOS, and then successfully transferring 6,500 EOS to the Binance Exchange.

On 19 November 2018, the EOS Lelego betting game was exploited via a random number vulnerability, allowing the attacker to win an abnormal rate of games and withdraw a reported 6,500 EOS. The contract operations were rapidly suspended to prevent further losses. The technical exploitation method is broadly inferred from contemporaneous EOS quiz game attacks, but no public Lelego code or transaction hashes are available. EOS Lelego used a random number generation mechanism with attacker-influenced or predictable contract variables, enabling outcome prediction and repeated winning.
